The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Adrazar]] maintained a '''domicile''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Adrazar's home was guarded by a [[Scyk/Legends|scyk]], a creature from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. That [[Unidentified scyk|specific scyk]] was the only one to have survived after a pack of scyks trained by Adrazar [[Death/Legends|killed]] each other in a frenzy.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adrazar's domicile was first mentioned in the Codex entry for scyks in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
